Why Most People Stay Stuck

## Random workouts.  Random results.

Apps don’t know you. Influencers don’t coach you. **Templates don’t adjust when life gets messy.** After enough false starts, most people think the problem is them.

It isn’t. The problem is the system.

That’s why most online personal training fails. You don’t need another app. You need a coach.

—**No structure** means every week starts from zero

—**No accountability** means motivation runs the program

—**No adjustments** means you plateau and stay there

—**No coach** means guessing what’s holding you back

10+Years CoachingFrom college athletes to everyday people done spinning their wheels.

1-on-1Built Around Your LifeStructured programming, weekly check-ins, and direct coach access.

100%Personalized ProgrammingNo recycled plans. No wasted effort. Every detail has a purpose.

![Certified online personal trainer Lordson Jonassaint, competitive bodybuilder](https://www.lordsonstrong.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/photo_12_2026-04-16_18-12-54.jpg)

Meet Lordson

## More than a trainer.  A coach with a standard.

I’m Lordson Jonassaint — certified personal trainer, former college athlete, and competitive bodybuilder. For over a decade, I’ve coached people in Central Florida to build strength, discipline, and structure that actually lasts.

I don’t sell generic plans. I don’t lower the standard because life got busy. I build coaching around real people, real constraints, and real execution.

✓Certified Personal Trainer (CPT)

✓College athlete — football and wrestling

✓Competitive bodybuilder, classic physique division

✓10+ years training clients in Central Florida

✓Remote coaching with direct support and weekly accountability

[Follow @lordson\_strong →](https://www.instagram.com/lordson_strong/)

## Everything you need.  Nothing you don’t.

No bundles. No upsells. One complete coaching system built around you — your schedule, your goals, your body’s response.

Personalized Training Program

Personalized Nutrition Plan

Weekly 1-on-1 Check-Ins

Review your week, adjust the program, and stay locked in on what’s actually working.

Direct Coach Access

Questions

## Online personal training,  straight answers.

How is this different from a workout app with a coach attached?

Apps build the program. A coach in an app is a chatbot with a face. Here, I build the program around your schedule, your equipment, and how your body actually responds. Then I adjust it every week based on what you did. The app is a delivery system. The coaching is the work.

Does online personal training work if I’ve already tried apps and quit?

Apps don’t quit. People quit apps. The reason is almost always the same. No one was watching. When nobody knows whether you trained, you don’t train. Weekly 1-on-1 check-ins fix that the same week, not the same quarter.

What does a week actually look like?

You get your week’s training and nutrition on Sunday. You execute. You log your sessions. We do a 1-on-1 check-in by end of week. I see what worked, what didn’t, what your body did. The next week’s program is built off that data. No templates. No copy-paste. No guessing.

One Step Left

## Done  guessing.  Start now.

Apply for coaching and get a personalized program, nutrition plan, and weekly accountability that actually moves the needle.
